whenToUse: A full-screen field-service dispatch console: job lanes, a city map and crew load.
Assigning jobs to the best-matching technician and messaging late customers.
avoidWhen: Booking rooms or resources on a timeline — use resource-calendar.
A static location directory — use list-08.
a11y: One h1 names the console; lanes are labelled regions and filters use aria-pressed.
Map pins and list rows share selection — make every action reachable from the list, not only the map.
